grammar.summary: 本课学习 can/could 表能力与航空叙事。

points.title: could 表过去能力
points.explanation: The plane could only get over the hills if it rose to 10,000 feet. could = was able to，过去能力/可能性。

examples.en: The plane was able to fly over the mountains.

points.title: 条件与结果叙事
points.explanation: if 条件句在故事中的作用：it would be able to... 过去将来 + 条件。

examples.en: The American explorer, R.E. Byrd, successfully flew over the North Pole.
examples.cn: 美国探险家 R.E. Byrd 成功飞越了北极。
